description: The CAWCR Wave Hindcast aggregates CSIRO and Bureau of Meteorology wave-model output from 1979 onward. WAVEWATCH III simulations use CFSR forcing through 2010 and CFSv2 thereafter. Hourly NetCDF4 products cover a global 0.4-degree grid, finer Australian and western Pacific nests, and 3,683 locations with wave spectra. Public download services provide boundary conditions for port, coastal-defence and offshore-energy simulations, and complement point buoy observations. The provider marks January 1979 as spin-up and warns that the pre-June-2013 variable t duplicates tm0m1 and must not be used as the intended mean period. The model version also changes in June 2013. These changes and grid resolution matter when comparing extremes across decades. Structured metadata state CC-BY-SA-4.0 and the collection is publicly available without a listed fee, but an older description requires permission for reproduction, modification or supply. This unresolved licence conflict is retained, not treating the deposit as unambiguously open. No terms were accepted and no data files were downloaded.
